Thanks for the flag, Marissa — I did a quick pass on the exec summary and the VSQ attached and have a few initial notes:

High-level
- Overall looks reasonable for a customer-facing product. Report is by a named 3rd party (GuardRail Security) which is good. Exec summary has scope callouts but lacks some evidence on remediation verification for older findings.

Open questions we should confirm with FintechCo (please ask):
1) Scope: The exec summary implies external + limited internal testing. Can they confirm whether internal network-based tests included privileged network segments and auth flows for the services we’re integrating with?
2) Scanning cadence & tooling: They mention quarterly vulnerability scans — are these authenticated scanners (credentialed) or unauthenticated network scans? Also which tooling (Tenable/Qualys/etc.)?
3) Remediation evidence: For any findings classified as High/Critical, do they provide remediation verification or re-test evidence? If not, we’ll request attestation and evidence for recent critical findings.
4) Disclosure & timelines: Their stated SLA (Critical=72h, High=7d) looks acceptable; need confirmation on how SLA is measured (issue created -> fix verified or vulnerability reported -> fix verified). Also confirm escalation path and on-call contact.
5) Data retention/logging: Do they retain vulnerability scan logs and pen test artifacts for at least 12 months? We prefer 12+ months for audit purposes.

I attached a short internal checklist and suggested clarifying questions. If FintechCo can answer these and provide redacted re-test evidence for critical findings, I think we can clear the security ask for production access.

Next steps
- Marissa/Stephanie: can you ask Alice to confirm the 5 items above and upload any re-test evidence to the Drive link (or send NDA for full report if needed)?

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi Rishi — thanks for the quick review and great questions. Answers below and I've added the SLA doc and an exec summary with redaction notes to the shared Drive link.

Responses to your items
1) Scope: Pen test covered external perimeter + internal network (internal testing focused on app-tier and auth flows; privileged network segments were out of scope). If you need full privileged-segment testing we can scope that as a follow-up pen test.
2) Scanning cadence & tooling: Quarterly authenticated scans using Tenable.io; annual external pen test by GuardRail Security.
3) Remediation evidence: For High/Critical items we provide re-test evidence (re-test report pages) and remediation attestations. I uploaded re-test excerpts for the two High items from 2023 to the Drive link.
4) SLA measurement: SLA measured from ticket creation in our vulnerability tracker -> remediation verification (we use Jira with SLA timers). Critical=72h is from ticket creation to verification. Escalation path: secops@fintechco.com -> on-call pager (details in SLA doc).
5) Data retention/logging: We retain scan results and pen test artifacts for 24 months.

Attachments & links (shared):
- FintechCo_Vuln_SLA_2027.pdf (Vulnerability management SLA, PDF)
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/fintechco/pen-test-summary (exec summary + re-test excerpts)

If you’d like the full report we can execute an NDA / redaction agreement and provide the full PDF. Otherwise the exec summary + re-test excerpts should be sufficient for your security review.
